title: Semgrep detects unsafe-add-mask workflow command in 14 GitHub Actions workflow files
signature: unsafe add mask workflow command detected in github actions workflows|Configuration

failed_jobs.name: github_actions_workflows_scan/semgrep
failed_jobs.symptom: Semgrep found 14 blocking findings (unsafe-add-mask-workflow-command) across 13 workflow files

key_errors: yaml.github-actions.security.audit.unsafe-add-mask-workflow-command: echo '::add-mask::${SCCACHE_AZURE_CONNECTION_STRING}' flagged in android.yml:146, build_doc.yml:131, ubuntu_22.yml:534, manylinux_2_28.yml:137, webassembly.yml:118 and others
Ran 11 rules on 66 files: 14 findings. Process completed with exit code 1.
root_cause: Semgrep rule 'yaml.github-actions.security.audit.unsafe-add-mask-workflow-command' flagged 14 occurrences of bare 'echo ::add-mask::' usage across 13 workflow files. The masking can be bypassed by injecting 'echo ::stop-commands::' before the add-mask line, leaking secrets (SCCACHE_AZURE_CONNECTION_STRING and MCP_GATEWAY_API_KEY) into logs. This is a deterministic configuration/security finding — no rerun will fix it.
recommended_actions: Replace bare 'echo ::add-mask::${SECRET}' with a stop-commands-protected wrapper: echo '::stop-commands::end_add_mask' / echo '::add-mask::${SECRET}' / echo '::end_add_mask::'
Apply fix to all 13 affected workflow files (android.yml, build_doc.yml, ubuntu_22.yml, manylinux_2_28.yml, webassembly.yml, ci-doctor-mq.lock.yml, ci-doctor.lock.yml and others)
prevention_strategies: Add semgrep pre-commit check to catch unsafe masking patterns in new workflow files before merge.
historical_context: First recorded in investigation 2026-07-29-07-18-34-331-30430242754. Same run, same 14 findings. Pattern count now 2.
